Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we’re excited to get the pilot PO in place. To speed vendor setup on our side I’ve attached our completed vendor intake form and W-9 (attached). Could you confirm what Redwood needs from us to create a vendor code and accept purchase orders?

Quick list of things we anticipate you might ask for — please correct me if I’m missing anything:
- Legal entity name and W-9 (attached)
- Bank details / ACH remittance form
- Contact for billing and invoices
- Insurance certificate and EU data handling docs (if applicable)
- Any SOC 2 / security questionnaire you require
- Preferred invoice format and where to send it

Also — for the pilot we’d like a small, expedited PO (<= $10k). Is there a fast path for that or does it need full procurement lead time?

Attachments: Nova_Sys_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf, Nova_W9.pdf

— Samir

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the intake packet. I reviewed the attachments and we’re almost set. To get a vendor code and issue a PO we typically need the following from the supplier side (what we need from you):

Required from Nova Systems:
- Executed W-9 (you already sent; file name checked)
- Completed ACH remittance form (attached PDF — please fill and return)
- Primary billing contact + invoice email (format: billing@company.com)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) and legal entity incorporation docs for US entities
- If you process customer data, a copy of SOC 2 Type II or completed security questionnaire

What Redwood will provide/us (what you can expect from us):
- Vendor code creation in our ERP and HubSpot (we’ll send vendor_id once complete)
- Standard PO template and PO number for the pilot (we typically do Net30)
- Dedicated onboarding contact for the pilot: Dev Patel (cc’d) for technical sandbox access
- Billing inbox to send invoices: invoices@redwood.com — include PO number on invoice header
- DocuSign link for our standard vendor terms (I’ll send next)

Expedited pilot process: we can create a temporary vendor code and issue a one-off pilot PO within 48 hours of receiving the completed ACH form + COI and confirmation of billing contact. For larger, contracted engagements we’ll go through the full legal review and DocuSign.

I’ve attached: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx and Redwood-ACH-Form.pdf. Please return the filled ACH form and COI; once we receive those Marissa will create the HubSpot deal and I’ll route to finance for the temporary PO.

Items I’ll action now:
- Marissa — can you open the HubSpot deal (DN-4921) and note the pilot scope?
- Dev — please prepare a sandbox key and short tech checklist for Nova once vendor code is created.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
